hooks.command: echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.content // ""' | grep -qE '(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|Bearer [a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|api_key\s*=|API_KEY\s*=|PASSWORD\s*=|SECRET\s*=)' && echo 'BLOCKED: possible secret in file write' && exit 1 || exit 0
FILE=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.path // ""') && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' && (cd nextjs-app && npx eslint "$FILE" --fix --quiet 2>&1 | tail -3) || exit 0
echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.path // ""' | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && (cd nextjs-app && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -10) || exit 0
FILE=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.path // ""') && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' && (cd nextjs-app && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | tail -8) || exit 0
